title: Strawberry Icebox Pie

items.item: fresh strawberries, hulled and thinly sliced (several small whole strawberries reserved for garnish)
prebaked graham cracker crust (homemade or store bought)

instructions: In a medium saucepan over medium-high heat, combine ¾ cup sugar, cranberry juice, 2 cups strawberries, cornstarch and salt.
Gently mash strawberries and bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer and cook, stirring frequently, until very thick, 1 to 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and cool slightly. Stir in remaining sliced strawberries and pour into crust. Cover with plastic, refrigerate until set, 6 to 8 hours or up to 1 day.
Beat cream until soft peaks form. Add remaining sugar and beat until soft peaks return, an additional 30 seconds.
Spread whipped cream over pie, leaving a 1 ½ border. Garnish with whole berries.
